verdict.rationale: Caveman's open-source CLI is documented as wrapping several supported agents, Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI, so the same compression and short-reply skill can be used across more than one agent. However, the evidence describes wrapping, not installing a single collection into each harness. Cursor appears only as an agent that runs inside Caveman's own app, not as an install target. missing for 10: documented install steps for each agent, per-harness instructions, a confirmed Cursor or broader 'others' install path, and independent hands-on confirmation of cross-agent installs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: The open-source Caveman CLI wraps supported agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
The open-source CLI, shorter replies and context compression work without one.
